products.name: Honey
products.tagline: 100% Pure Raw Wildflower Honey • Flying from happy bees!
products.description: Banaya Enterprise 100% Pure Wildflower Honey is harvested directly from happy bees and natural honeycombs using traditional cold filtering without heating, pasteurization, or adulteration. Rich in natural bee pollen, live enzymes, and organic floral nectars, this golden nectar offers wholesome nutrition and natural sweetness for the entire family.
keyBenefits: Natural immune enhancer rich in antioxidants and active enzymes
Effective traditional remedy for cough, sore throat, and respiratory comfort
Great healthy substitute for refined white sugar in teas, milks, and desserts
Supports gut health and smooth digestion when taken with lukewarm water
products.howToUse: Take 1-2 teaspoons directly on an empty stomach every morning, or mix with lukewarm water and a squeeze of fresh lemon. Do not heat directly or boil.

products.name: Magarantha Thean
products.tagline: Pollen-Enriched Raw Forest Honey from Western Ghats
products.description: Magarantha Thean (Bee Pollen Honey) is naturally concentrated with active flower pollen collected by wild honey bees from diverse medicinal herbs in deep virgin forests. Unheated and free from added corn syrups, this dark amber elixir retains its natural living enzymes, flavonoids, and vital bio-nutrients.
keyBenefits: Boosts cellular immunity, daily stamina, and physical endurance naturally
Rich in bioactive pollen, antioxidants, B-vitamins & natural digestive enzymes
Soothes throat irritation and supports seasonal allergy resistance
A wholesome natural pre-workout energizer and nutritional powerhouse
products.howToUse: Take 1 to 2 teaspoons directly on an empty stomach every morning, or mix with lukewarm water and lemon. Never add to boiling liquids.

products.name: Malai Thean
products.description: Harvested ethically from giant wild rock bee colonies (Apis dorsata) nestled high in cliff precipices of the Eastern and Western Ghats. Malai Thean carries a rich, deep woody aroma and unparalleled therapeutic potency derived from wild medicinal hill herbs and tall mountain tree canopies.
keyBenefits: Contains high trace minerals: Iron, Zinc, Potassium, and Magnesium
Promotes digestive wellness and gut microbiome balance
Gentle on glycemic response compared to processed white sugars
Traditional Ayurvedic remedy for deep vitality and cellular rejuvenation
products.howToUse: Consume 1 tablespoon with lukewarm milk at night or with warm herbal decoctions. Ideal for daily sweetening.

products.name: Rose Gulkand
products.tagline: Sun-Cured Damask Rose Petal Preserve with Forest Honey
products.description: Slowly sun-cooked for 45 days in traditional glass containers using aromatic indigenous Damask Rose (Chaiti Gulab) petals, natural rock sugar (Dhaga Mishri), and pure raw honey. This authentic Ayurvedic preparation acts as a natural body coolant and digestive rejuvenator.
ingredients: Fresh Native Damask Rose Petals (Rosa damascena)
keyBenefits: Pacifies excess Pitta, reducing body heat, acidity, and fatigue
Alleviates acid reflux, bloating, and stomach inflammation
Enhances natural skin glow and calms stress-induced breakouts
Improves sleep quality and calms the nervous system
products.howToUse: Take 1 to 2 teaspoons directly twice daily after meals, or blend into chilled milk to make a refreshing rose beverage.

products.name: Honey Amla
products.tagline: Wild Forest Honey-Soaked Mountain Indian Gooseberry
products.description: Whole organic wild Indian Gooseberries (Amla / Nellikai) pricked and steeped for months in pure raw multifloral honey. The natural astringency and sourness of fresh vitamin-rich Amla balances harmoniously with the sweet honey to create a delicious, therapeutic daily immunity booster.
keyBenefits: Extremely rich source of bio-available Vitamin C and natural polyphenols
Strengthens hair roots, delays premature graying, and promotes clear skin
Enhances liver function and accelerates digestive metabolism
Supports healthy eyesight, hemoglobin levels, and cellular vitality
products.howToUse: Eat 1 to 2 soaked Amla pieces daily in the morning or after meals, sipping a spoonful of the infused honey syrup.

products.name: Mixed Nuts
products.tagline: Gourmet Selection of Roasted & Raw Premium Dry Fruits & Seeds
products.description: A luxurious master-blend of hand-selected Kashmiri Mamra Almonds, W240 Goa Cashew Nuts, Iranian Green Pistachios, Chilean Walnuts, Afghan Black Raisins, and nutrient-dense Pumpkin & Sunflower Seeds. Lightly slow-roasted without oil to seal in crunch and essential fatty acids.
keyBenefits: Rich in Omega-3 fatty acids for cognitive and cardiovascular health
Provides 8g+ of clean plant protein and dietary fiber per serving
Sustained morning energy without blood sugar spikes
Zero trans fats, zero added salt, completely non-GMO
products.howToUse: Enjoy a handful (30g) as an energizing mid-day snack, breakfast topping for porridge, or blend into milk smoothies.

products.name: ABC Malt
products.description: Banaya Enterprise Abc Malt is a wholesome blend of Apple, Beetroot, Carrot, Dates, Nuts & Seeds, Makhana, and Cane Jaggery. 100% natural, healthy, tasty, and nutritious for the entire family with zero added preservatives and no artificial flavours.
keyBenefits: Boosts heart health and vitality
Helps to get clear & glowing skin
Increases haemoglobin level in blood
Improves eye health and vision clarity
Detoxifies the body naturally
products.howToUse:
1. Add 1-2 teaspoon malt into a cup.
2. Add 150ml of hot milk.
3. Mix it well and enjoy your malt.

products.name: Ghee
products.tagline: Traditional A2 Bilona Churned Golden Desi Cow Ghee
products.description: Prepared strictly through the ancient Vedic Bilona method: fresh whole milk from freely-grazed indigenous Indian Gir & Kangayam cows is cultured into curd, hand-churned with a wooden churner (Bilona) to separate cultured butter (Makkhan), and slow-boiled in brass cauldrons with moringa leaves to yield fragrant granular golden ghee.
ingredients: 100% Cultured Grass-Fed Desi Cow Milk Fat (A2 Beta-Casein)
keyBenefits: Rich in fat-soluble vitamins (A, D, E, K2) and healthy Butyric Acid
Lubricates joints, nourishes brain tissues, and enhances digestion (Agni)
Granular texture with an intoxicating traditional nutty aroma
100% free from preservatives, colors, and synthetic additives
products.howToUse: Drizzle 1 teaspoon over hot steamed rice, dosas, rotis, or lentil dal. Highly recommended for daily Ayurvedic cooking and infant nutrition.

products.name: Natural Soap
products.tagline: Handcrafted Cold Process Herbal Bath Bar with Neem, Tulsi & Virgin Coconut Oil
products.description: Cured naturally for 6 weeks, this artisanal cold-process bathing bar is formulated with pure wood-pressed coconut oil, fresh crushed neem leaves, sacred holy basil (Tulsi), raw turmeric, and unrefined Shea butter. Gently cleanses without stripping essential skin moisture.
keyBenefits: Natural antibacterial and antifungal protection for daily hygiene
Calms skin irritation, back acne, and body odors naturally
Creamy rich lather that leaves skin velvety soft and deeply hydrated
Zero palm oil, zero chemical fragrances, biodegradable and safe for all skin types
products.howToUse: Lather between wet palms or with a natural loofah, apply all over body during bath or shower, and rinse clean with water.

products.name: Mudavatukal Soup Mix
products.tagline: Banaya Enterprises Authentic Mudavattukkal Joint Care & Immunity Soup Mix
products.description: Authentic Banaya Enterprises Mudavattukkal Soup Mix prepared with traditional Western Ghats Mudavattukal (Drynaria quercifolia / Oak-leaf fern rhizome) blended with wholesome moong dal and native spices. Highly esteemed in Siddha and folk traditions for relieving knee pain, joint stiffness, reducing inflammation, and maintaining healthy mobility.
keyBenefits: Alleviates joint pain, stiffness, and swelling
Controls blood sugar level naturally
Boosts immunity & detoxifies the liver
Dietary fiber content supports healthy digestion
Has potent natural anti-inflammatory properties
products.howToUse: Mix 5g of soup powder with 100ml water in a kettle and boil for one minute.

products.name: Karuppukavani Kanji (Black Rice Powder)
products.tagline: Ancient Chettinad Royal Black Rice Porridge & Health Mix
products.description: Banaya Enterprise Karuppu Kavuni Kanji Mix is an authentic traditional heritage porridge blend crafted from Ancient Karupu kavuni black rice, Poongar rice, Karuppu kollu, Pearl millet, Pepper, Moong dal, Jeera, and Garlic. Healthy, tasty, and nutritious mix for the whole family.
keyBenefits: Helps weight management and healthy metabolism
Rich in anthocyanin antioxidants
Rich in dietary fibre for digestive wellness
Helps reduce cholesterol and maintain heart wellness
products.howToUse:
1. Add 2 tsp of porridge mix in 1.5 glass of water.
2. Add a pinch of salt & stir well.
3. Cook for 5 mins in low heat.
4. Add Buttermilk before consume.

products.name: Curry Leaf Powder
products.tagline: Aromatic Shade-Dried Kariveppilai Rice & Idli Podi for Iron & Hair Vitality
products.description: Banaya Enterprises Organic Curry Leaf Powder (Kariveppilai) is 100% organic, gluten-free, with no additives. Formulated to support digestion, metabolic health, and natural beauty. Handpicked fresh leaves shade-dried to retain volatile essential nutrients and bioavailable minerals.
keyBenefits: Provides vital nutrients and natural antioxidants
Supports digestion, metabolic health, and natural beauty
Adds rich authentic herbal flavour to meals and drinks
Clean & plant-based, 100% organic, gluten-free with no additives
products.howToUse: Suggested to use: 1 teaspoon curry leaf powder in 100 ml of hot water. Mix well and drink, or sprinkle into meals, hot rice with ghee, dosas, and chutneys.
products.origin: Banaya Enterprises Organic Groves, Tamil Nadu (FSSAI: 22426089000267)

products.name: Murungai Leaf Powder
products.tagline: 100% Pure Organic Murungai Keerai Superfood Powder for Immunity & Eye Health
products.description: Banaya Enterprises Organic Murungai Keerai Powder is prepared from carefully selected native drumstick moringa leaves. 100% organic, gluten-free, with no additives. Formulated to boost natural immunity and maintain good eye health.
ingredients: 100% Pure Organic Shade-Dried Murungai Keerai (Moringa Leaves)
keyBenefits: Helps boost immunity and natural defense mechanisms
Maintains good eye health and clear vision
Rich in organic plant calcium, protein, and bioavailable iron
100% organic, gluten-free, and free from any synthetic additives
